description: Unified legal, homologation, functional safety, cybersecurity, and AI safety standards knowledge graph for international and national automated driving (L2 through L4).
governing_bodies: UNECE (World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations WP.29)
German Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (BMDV)

regulations.full_title: SAE J3016:2021 - Taxonomy and Definitions for Terms Related to Driving Automation Systems for On-Road Motor Vehicles

clauses.title: Dynamic Driving Task (DDT) Operational & Tactical Boundary
clauses.requirement_summary: System must formally delineate operational (steering, braking) and tactical (lane changes, gaps) DDT elements from strategic routing. Full DDT allocated to ADS for Levels 3-5.

clauses.title: DDT Fallback Allocation & Human Roles
clauses.requirement_summary: At L2/L2+, driver retains continuous OEDR and fallback responsibility. At L3, fallback-ready user responds to transition demand within lead time; ADS performs fallback if user fails. At L4, ADS autonomously achieves minimal risk condition without human fallback.

regulations.full_title: UNECE Regulation No. 171 - Uniform Provisions Concerning the Approval of Vehicles with Regard to Driver Control Assistance Systems (DCAS)

clauses.title: Continuous Driver Monitoring
clauses.requirement_summary: System must monitor driver engagement (hands-on or eyes-on) and provide cascading warnings within 3.0s of distraction detection.

clauses.title: ODD Boundary Warning & Override
clauses.requirement_summary: System must clearly indicate functional boundary approaches with audible and optical warnings, and driver steering override must be seamless.

regulations.full_title: UNECE Regulation No. 157 - Automated Lane Keeping Systems

clauses.title: Dynamic Driving Task (DDT) Control
clauses.requirement_summary: System assumes full lateral and longitudinal control without requiring driver attention until Transition Demand is issued.

clauses.title: Transition Demand (TOR) and Minimum Risk Maneuver (MRM)
clauses.requirement_summary: System shall issue a transition demand at least 10s prior to foreseeable ODD exit. If driver does not resume control, system initiates an MRM to bring vehicle to a standstill.

clauses.title: Data Storage System for Automated Driving (DSSAD)
clauses.requirement_summary: Vehicle must log timestamped events: system activation/deactivation, transition demand, driver override, and MRM initiation into crash-hardened memory.

clauses.title: Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA)
clauses.requirement_summary: Systematic identification of hazardous events and ASIL allocation based on Severity (S), Exposure (E), and Controllability (C).

clauses.title: Technical Safety Concept & FTTI
clauses.requirement_summary: Fault Tolerant Time Interval (FTTI) definition and architectural redundancy allocation to prevent single points of failure.

clauses.title: Hardware Metrics & Software Unit Safety
clauses.requirement_summary: Hardware single-point fault metric (SPFM >= 99% for ASIL D) and software static verification (MISRA-C, zero dynamic memory, recursion bounds).

regulations.full_title: ISO 21448:2022 Road Vehicles - Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF)

clauses.title: Evaluation of Functional Insufficiencies and Triggering Conditions
clauses.requirement_summary: Systematic cataloging of environmental and operational triggers (sun glare, weather, road markings, spray) that cause perception/actuation limits.

clauses.title: Validation of SOTIF Scenarios & Residual Risk
clauses.requirement_summary: Quantitative scenario testing to verify that unknown unsafe scenarios (Area 3) are reduced to an acceptable residual risk level.

clauses.title: Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA)
clauses.requirement_summary: Asset identification, threat scenarios, attack paths, and attack feasibility rating to determine Cybersecurity Assurance Levels (CAL 1-4).

clauses.title: Cybersecurity Concept & SecOC Cryptographic Controls
clauses.requirement_summary: Allocation of cybersecurity requirements, secure boot, Hardware Security Module (HSM) keys, and message authentication (AUTOSAR SecOC CMAC).

regulations.full_title: ISO/PAS 8800:2024 Road Vehicles - Safety and Artificial Intelligence

clauses.title: AI Dataset Quality and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Robustness
clauses.requirement_summary: Dataset balance, demographic/geographic representation, and neural network epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty quantification.

clauses.title: AI Safety Life Cycle & Supervisory Gating
clauses.requirement_summary: Runtime supervisory safety wrappers that detect high model uncertainty or OOD inputs and trigger deterministic fail-operational fallbacks.

regulations.full_title: ISO 34503:2023 Road Vehicles - Test Scenarios for Automated Driving Systems - Taxonomy for Operational Design Domain (ODD)

clauses.title: Hierarchical ODD Categorization Framework
clauses.requirement_summary: Standardized hierarchical decomposition across Scenery (road geometry, markings, surfaces), Environmental conditions (weather, lighting), and Dynamic elements.

regulations.full_title: ISO 34502:2022 Road Vehicles - Test Scenarios for Automated Driving Systems - Scenario-Based Safety Evaluation Framework

clauses.title: Three-Tier Scenario Decomposition (Functional, Logical, Concrete)
clauses.requirement_summary: Transformation of traffic safety concepts from qualitative Functional Scenarios, to parametric Logical Scenarios, down to executable Concrete Scenarios in OpenSCENARIO format.

regulations.full_title: ANSI/UL 4600:2023 Standard for Evaluation of Autonomous Products

clauses.title: Goal Structuring Notation (GSN) Autonomous Safety Case
clauses.requirement_summary: Structured evidentiary safety argument covering system dependability, non-human driver behaviors, operational edge cases, and field feedback mechanisms.

regulations.full_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council (EU Artificial Intelligence Act)

clauses.title: Risk Management & High-Risk AI Data Governance
clauses.requirement_summary: High-risk AI systems in vehicles must undergo continuous risk management, bias audits, and representativeness validation on training and validation sets.

clauses.title: Human Oversight, Robustness & Cybersecurity
clauses.requirement_summary: Appropriate human-machine interface controls enabling human oversight, alongside proven resilience against adversarial attacks and data drift.

regulations.full_title: UNECE Regulation No. 155 - Cyber Security Management System

clauses.title: Threat Analysis & Risk Assessment (TARA)
clauses.requirement_summary: Continuous mitigation of vehicle cyber threats across connected services, OTA channels, and in-vehicle buses.

regulations.full_title: UNECE Regulation No. 156 - Software Update and Management System

clauses.title: Regulation X Software Identification Number (RXSWIN)
clauses.requirement_summary: Every OTA update must verify type-approved software version hashes prior to activation on public roads.

regulations.full_title: German Autonomous Driving Act (StVG § 1a-1f) & AFGBV Regulation

clauses.title: Technical Supervision & Minimal Risk State
clauses.requirement_summary: Vehicles without driver must connect to external Technical Supervisor and autonomously execute emergency maneuvers into risk-free zones.
